request.spec:
Periods can be generated: a from-date and a to-date and a button create one period per calendar
month from the from-date's month to the to-date's month, each running from the first to the last
day of its month (February ends on the 28th or 29th), named yyyy-mm, each written as PERIOD_ADDED.
A month whose name is already a period, or whose days overlap a period on the sheet, is left out
and the others are still made. Show how many were made. A to-date before the from-date is refused
with an error.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Periods can be generated: a from-date and a to-date and a button create one period per calendar
month from the from-date's month to the to-date's month, each running from the first to the last
day of its month (February ends on the 28th or 29th), named yyyy-mm, each written as PERIOD_ADDED.
A month whose name is already a period, or whose days overlap a period on the sheet, is left out

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit

AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Periods can now be generated by month, and all 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

**How it works:**
- **Server:** a new route, `POST /api/sheets/{sheetId}/periods/generate`, works through each month from the from-date's month to the to-date's month. Each period runs from the 1st to the last day of its month (so February ends on the 28th or 29th) and is named `yyyy-mm`. A month is skipped, and the rest still made, if its name is already a period on the sheet or its days overlap an existing one. Each period made writes a `PERIOD_ADDED` audit line in the same form as adding a period by hand. The reply says how many were made.
- **Refusals:** a to-date before the from-date is refused with an error and writes nothing. I also made it require a to-date, accept a blank from-date as the sheet's today, and refuse viewers — the same rules the existing add-period form follows.
- **Screen:** the Periods panel has a new generate form with `period-generate-from`, `period-generate-to` and `period-generate` (the button). After a run it shows the count in `period-generated`; a refusal shows `period-generate-error`. The count disappears while a run is in progress, and the error clears when the form is changed or submitted again.

The new server files are in `src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/period/` (`ValidateGeneratePeriods`, `GeneratePeriods`, `RespondWithGeneratedPeriods`, plus the request, range and response records), with the route in `periods/generate.POST.yml`. The form is in `src/main/frontend/features/periods/periods.slot.tsx`. No database change was needed.
